articles.summary: PEMBROKE, BERMUDA, May 19, 2025 — Hamilton Insurance Group, Ltd. (NYSE: HG) (“Hamilton” or the “Company”) announced today that Karen Green and David Priebe have been appointed to the Company’s Board of Directors, effective May 15, 2025. articles.title: Karen Green and David Priebe Join Hamilton Board of Directors
